candidate_decisions.reason: The seven nominated focus branches form a bounded practice reading: prayer and continuing oversight lead into directing recognized good and restraining wrong, while 31:15 and 31:19 show that the practice remains relational and is carried into measured conduct. Each branch has a focus carrier and a distinct pericope trigger.

All four nominated branches land: patience contains the response to what befalls, resolve supplies decisive persistence, and the immediate context makes hidden impact and continued measured conduct live triggers. The route facet remains a contextual echo of the focus noun.

The exact HFT trace names the supplied father-son and parental-pressure passages, maps the context roles to the focus command, and returns through 31:17:4. Its legacy-unbound identity and parent-child alternative qualify the finding; they do not erase the traced relation.

The exact 31:16 context trace supplies the hidden-weight, grain, enclosure, subtle-access, and knowledge roles, with a return through the focus occurrence 31:17:12:1. Registered target-reaching facets are copied exactly; unresolved context branches remain attributed.

The trace's 31:18–19 posture, gait, lowering, and voice roles return through the focus commands and munkar word. The registered munkar sound specialization lands with its core facet; unresolved context branches are retained only as attributed evidence.

findings.title: Sustained worship and ethical restraint
findings.claim: Across the surrounding counsel, establishing prayer is joined to directing recognized good and restraining reprehensible conduct; the later measured gait and voice carry that ethical practice into manner.
findings.mechanism: The focus words carry prescribed worship, ongoing care, command, recognized good, reprehensible conduct, and active restraint. In 31:15, refusal of wrongdoing coexists with continued ma'ruf companionship; 31:19 then gives measured conduct and restrained speech. Their contact makes the focus list read as an ordered practice that continues from worship into social action and its manner.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the listed acts as one sustained ethical discipline with both relational and bodily form.
findings.containment: The verse still says to establish prayer, enjoin good, forbid wrong, and endure. The pericope relation adds continuity and manner without making the next instructions the only way to enact the focus commands or erasing the family-specific setting of 31:15.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers and nominated branches are supplied, and the two context ayat contain the relevant conduct. The synthesis joins a single-reader channel nomination to those exact pericope contacts.

findings.title: Impact held by a fixed resolve

findings.mechanism: The focus joins what befalls the son to self-restraint and decisive resolve. The preceding verse places a mustard-grain weight inside rock, heaven, or earth and says God brings it; an HFT trace maps the focus occurrence to target-reaching. These contacts extend a first picture of visible retaliation to consequences whose location, timing, or scale may be hidden. The branch of resolve as a course that does not turn then meets the measured walking of 31:19.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see patience as a held response to impacts that need not be immediately visible, and resolve as direction made perceptible in continued conduct.
findings.containment: The ordinary adversity reading remains live. Verse 31:16 may concern divine accounting without naming an injury, and the route sense is a contextual echo on the noun of resolve, not a replacement translation.

epistemic.reason: The channel nomination supplies the focus branches; exact pericope Arabic supports the contacts, while the hidden-consequence trace is legacy-unbound and explicitly leaves divine accounting as an alternative.
